headline: Indigenous futurism on the street, Inuit knowledge in forecasting
digest: Skawennati's augmented-reality work for the Conseil des arts de Montréal reimagined the Three Sisters as superheroes, a public Indigenous-futurist piece. At Mila's 2026 Indigenous AI Gathering, Mila and PolArctic announced a sea-ice forecasting partnership combining Inuit knowledge, ocean science and satellite data. Mila also published on AI-driven disinformation.
